newsitem.title: CHINA: China's VCD output surges in first half of 1997.
newsitem.headline: China's VCD output surges in first half of 1997.

text.p: China's video compact disc (VCD) output surged to four million in the first half of 1997 from 20,000 in 1994, accounting for 85 percent of the total market share, the Business News said on Monday.
The newspaper did not give comparative figures for 1996.
Only 15 of more than 300 domestic producers had annual output above 50,000, the newspaper said, adding that VCD producers should merge to make production more economical.
